# Internal Control System [102-11]

PermataBank's internal control system serves to manage risk within tolerance limits. In operational activities, the internal control system is designed and implemented to manage and control risks, however, not to eliminate risks. As a result, the internal control system aims to provide adequate assurance on the achievement of control in an entity, however does not provide absolute guarantee on any material misstatement, loss, or other unforeseeable circumstances.

Risk governance structure is performed in accordance with the Three Lines of Defense concept, where each line of control has its own duties and responsibilities, so as to ensure the effectiveness of the risk management process in maintaining PermataBank's risk profile in risk tolerance and risk appetite.

First Line of Defence is supporting business activities to generate revenue as own and manage the risks. The Business Unit as the first line of defense is responsible for ensuring the business decision making process is always in line with the approved Risk Management Framework.

Second Line of Defense is the control functions independent of the First Line that provide oversight and challenge of risk management to provide confidence to the Board of Directors.

The Internal Audit Unit (IAU) as the Third Line of Defense provides an independent assurance of control effectiveness that support First Line's risk management for its business activities, and the processes carried out by Second Line. The Head of IAU directly reports to the President Director.

# Sustainable Governance Implementation Challenges

PermataBank is committed to implementing a bankwide GCG. The implementation of sustainable finance principles in sustainable governance is PermataBank's commitment to exercise governance by taking into account the environmental, social and governance aspects.

In implementing sustainable governance, the challenge faced by PermataBank to date is the absence of special unit functioning to oversee the implementation and execution of sustainable finance in order to be able to perform more effectively. In the future, the management of PermataBank will review the needs for adjusting its organization including the needs of such special unit.

In addition to organizational development, PermataBank still needs to improve the knowledge and competence of its employees regarding the implementation of sustainable financial governance needed to increase the provision of products and/or services that are environmentally friendly and in line with the principles of sustainable finance. Furthermore, PermataBank will review periodically the requirement for developing sustainable financial competencies for various relevant functions and levels.

- Menghindari benturan kepentingan.

- Menjaga kerahasiaan dan perlindungan informasi dan data.
- Memperlakukan karyawan dengan adil.

- Sikap dan perilaku.

## Fraud Risk Management (FRM)

Fraud di perbankan sangat berkaitan dengan risiko kredit dan risiko reputasi. Akibat dari fraud dapat menimbulkan dampak yang merugikan bagi nasabah serta merusak reputasi serta kepercayaan yang telah dibangun oleh PermataBank. Manajemen risiko fraud terangkum dalam Kebijakan Strategi Anti Fraud. Kebijakan ini meliputi aktivitas pencegahan, pendeteksian, pemberian tanggapan, proses investigasi, dan efek jera yang dijabarkan dalam strategi yang lengkap untuk mengelola risiko fraud di PermataBank dalam rangka mencapai level tertinggi dalam hal integritas bisnis. Tanggung jawab ini dikelola unit kerja Fraud Risk Management (FRM) di bawah koordinasi Direktorat Hukum dan Kepatuhan.

PermataBank melaksanakan Fraud Risk Assessment (FRA) yaitu kajian berkelanjutan untuk mengevaluasi pencegahan, pendeteksian dan tanggapan terhadap setiap potensi skema dan peristiwa fraud. FRA akan dilakukan pada unit/produk/proses/aktivitas yang memiliki risiko fraud yang cukup tinggi, baik yang terpantau dari kenaikan insiden fraud maupun penambahan volume yang signifikan atau dari kejadian fraud yang terjadi di industri Perbankan saat ini.

## Internal Fraud

PermataBank melakukan berbagai upaya pencegahan terhadap kemungkinan terjadinya internal fraud, diantaranya dengan cara:

a. Menyelenggarakan training webinar, diskusi atau sharing kasus secara online dengan unit-unit yang berkepentingan, terkait dengan kasus-kasus fraud yang sedang trend di industri dan bagaimana mencegah agar tidak terjadi di PermataBank.
b. Melakukan diskusi secara regular dengan unit kerja Deteksi Fraud agar dapat meningkatkan kemampuan deteksi unit kerja tersebut.
c. Melakukan investigasi jarak jauh atau secara online, dengan melakukan kerjasama dengan unit kontrol dimana kasus fraud tersebut terjadi sehingga hasil investigasi tetap berkualitas dan bisa menemukan akar permasalahan sehingga dapat memberikan

## Fraud Risk Management (FRM)

Fraud in banking is closely related to credit risk and reputation risk. The consequences of fraud can have an adverse impact on customers and damage the reputation and trust that has been built by PermataBank. Fraud risk management is summarized in the Strategy of Anti-Fraud Policy. The policy includes preventive actions, detection, response, investigation process and deterrent effects in a complete strategy to manage fraud risks in PermataBank in order to reach the highest level of business integrity. This responsibility is managed by the Fraud Risk Management (FRM) working unit under the coordination of the Legal and Compliance Directorate.

PermataBank carries out a Fraud Risk Assessment (FRA), which is an ongoing study to evaluate prevention, detection and response to any potential fraud schemes and events. FRA will be performed on units/products/processes/activities with a high risk of fraud, assessed by the increase of fraud incidents, or significantly increased in volume or based on banking industry trends.

## Speak-Up

Speak-Up merupakan sistem whistleblowing berupa sarana/media bagi PermataBankers untuk melaporkan pelanggaran-pelanggaran dan malpraktek, baik berupa fraud maupun pelanggaran Kode Etik, termasuk kecurigaan atas tindakan pelanggaran. Speak-Up diperkenalkan di PermataBank sejak tahun 2008.

## Mekanisme Speak-up

Semua karyawan PermataBank dapat melaporkan setiap indikasi terjadinya pelanggaran (fraud) dan diwajibkan melaporkan setiap pelanggaran yang dilakukan oleh karyawan lain kepada manajemen melalui saluran Speak-Up yang telah disediakan berupa surat elektronik, layanan pesan singkat (SMS), telepon, dan surat (PO Box). Manajemen PermataBank akan melakukan evaluasi dan analisis terhadap semua laporan yang diperoleh melalui Speak-Up, dan selanjutnya melakukan tindakan lanjut yang melibatkan unit kerja terkait, seperti Fraud Risk Management, Internal Audit, Legal, Human Resources ataupun pihak lain, jika diperlukan.

Mekanisme Sistem Whistleblowing (Speak-Up) di PermataBank, dilakukan dengan memperhatikan prinsip-prinsip berikut:

- Laporan bersifat rahasia. Hanya administrator dan Speak-Up Council yang telah ditunjuk manajemen yang memiliki wewenang untuk mengetahui isi laporan.
- Pelapor dapat memilih 1 dari tiga prinsip anonim, yaitu: full disclosure (mencantumkan identitas), partial anonymity (identitas hanya disampaikan kepada administrator) atau anonymous (tidak mencantumkan identitas).
- Pihak pelapor dibebaskan dari segala sanksi bila ternyata laporannya tidak dapat dibuktikan kebenarannya.
- PermataBank menjamin semua pihak pelapor bahwa laporan-laporan mereka tidak akan mempengaruhi penilaian kinerja dan/atau perjalanan karier mereka di PermataBank.

## Speak-Up

Speak-Up is a whistleblowing system in the form of a facility/media for PermataBankers to report infringements and malpractices, whether they are fraud or violations against the Code of Conduct, including suspicion of violations. PermataBank has introduced Speak-Up since 2008.

## Speak-up Mechanism

All PermataBank's employees may report any indication of violation (or fraud) and are required to report any infringements committed by other employees to the company's management via the Speak-Up channel provided in the form of electronic mail, short message service (SMS), telephone and mail (PO Box). PermataBank's management will evaluate and analyze all reports obtained through Speak-Up, and then carry out follow-up actions involving relevant working units, such as Fraud Risk Management, Internal Audit, Legal, Human Resources or other parties, if necessary.

The Whistleblowing System mechanism (Speak-Up) at PermataBank is implemented by paying attention to the following principles:

- All reports are confidential. Only Speak-Up administrators and council, who is previously appointed by the management, have the authority to know the contents of the report.
- The whistleblowers may select one of three principles of anonymity, i.e.: full disclosure (identity is included), partial anonymity (identity is only submitted to the administrator) or anonymous (identity in not included).
- The informant will be not be held accountable if his/her report is unproven.
- PermataBank guarantees that the report submitted by an informant will not affect his/her performance evaluation/career in PermataBank.

# Tata Kelola Pemasok Barang dan Jasa

Governance of Goods and Services Suppliers [102-18]

PermataBank memanfaatkan produk dan jasa dari vendor pemasok, termasuk diantaranya untuk keperluan barang dan jasa perkantoran, konstruksi, serta berbagai jasa untuk keperluan penjualan, kebersihan, transportasi maupun di bidang teknologi informasi, serta penyedia jasa konsultasi (seperti konsultan hukum, notaris, penilai, dan lain-lain).

PermataBank menerapkan Kebijakan Pengadaan dan Pengelolaan Vendor (Procurement and Vendor Management Policy) yang meliputi kebijakan yang berkaitan dengan pengelolaan vendor dalam kegiatan rutin untuk memastikan kinerja vendor sesuai dengan perjanjian dan Service Level Agreement (SLA) yang telah disepakati.

Sesuai Kebijakan Pengadaan, beberapa ketentuan pengelolaan vendor di PermataBank antara lain adalah:

a. Pengadaan barang dan jasa dengan nilai sama dengan dan di atas Rp100 juta harus dilakukan melalui unit Procurement Vendor Management (PVM) sesuai dengan kriteria dalam prosedur.
b. Proses pengadaan terdiri dari tahap identifikasi kebutuhan dan sumber pengadaan, tahap persiapan untuk sukses yang di dalamnya termasuk pembuatan rencana pengadaan dan strategi, tahap proses tender dan pembuatan keputusan, serta tahap penyelesaian dan serah terima pengelolaan.
c. Pengadaan dilakukan bersama antara User dan unit PVM. Untuk pengadaan sama dengan dan di atas Rp100 juta, permohonan pengadaan diajukan oleh User kepada PVM melalui sistem Procurement Vendor Management System (PVMS) dan selanjutnya diproses oleh PVM.
d. Dalam melakukan pengadaan, dilakukan due diligence atas vendor yang masuk dalam daftar, termasuk melakukan melakukan pemeriksaan dokumen legal vendor, kunjungan ke vendor dan analisa kondisi keuangan vendor sesuai kebutuhan.
e. Skoring dilakukan bersama-sama dengan pihak User dan PVM dengan cakupan penilaian:

1. Harga yang kompetitif.
2. Keahlian dan pengalaman termasuk sertifikasi teknis dari kontraktor.

PermataBank utilizes products and services from supplier vendors, including for the purposes of office goods and services, construction, and various services for sectors such as sales, cleaning, transportation and information technology, as well as consulting service providers (e.g. legal consultants, notaries, appraisers, and etc).

PermataBank implements a Procurement and Vendor Management Policy which includes provisions related to vendor management in routine activities to ensure the performance of vendors adheres to the agreed agreement and Service Level Agreement (SLA).

According to the Procurement Policy, several vendor management provisions applicable in PermataBank include:

a. Procurement of goods and services with a value equal to and above IDR100 million shall be done through the Procurement Vendor Management (PVM) unit according to the criteria in the procedure.
b. The procurement process consists of several stages, i.e. the identification of procurement needs and sources, the preparation for success, including the preparation of procurement plan and strategy, the tender process and decision making, and the completion and management handover.
c. The procurement is carried out jointly between the User and the PVM unit. For procurement equal to and above IDR100 million, a procurement request is submitted by the User to the PVM through the Procurement Vendor Management System (PVMS) and subsequently processed by the PVM.
d. In conducting the procurement, due diligence is carried out on vendors registered in the list, which includes examining vendor's legal documents, visiting vendor's sites and analyzing vendor's financial conditions as needed.
e. The scoring is carried out together by the User and the PVM with the following scope of the assessment:

1. Competitive price.
2. Expertise and experience including technical certifications from contractors.

# Tentang Laporan Keberlanjutan

## About Sustainability Report

Laporan Keberlanjutan atau "Laporan" dari PT Bank Permata Tbk ("PermataBank") periode tahun 2020 ini merupakan edisi keenam sejak pertama kali diterbitkan di tahun 2014. Melalui Laporan ini, PermataBank memberikan gambaran upaya mewujudkan komitmen dalam mendukung pembangunan negeri melalui penyediaan produk dan layanan perbankan yang mudah dijangkau bagi seluruh lapisan masyarakat. Laporan ini meliputi informasi terkini tentang kinerja keberlanjutan PermataBank di bidang ekonomi, sosial, lingkungan hidup, dan tata kelola bagi pemangku kepentingan. Informasi yang terdapat dalam laporan ini merupakan pelengkap informasi yang disajikan dalam Laporan Tahunan PermataBank tahun 2020.

Melalui Laporan ini, juga diuraikan realisasi berbagai program yang menunjukan dukungan PermataBank terhadap pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan/Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) sebagaimana sudah ditetapkan oleh Pemerintah Republik Indonesia melalui Peraturan Presiden Nomor 59 Tahun 2017 tentang Pelaksanaan Pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (PP 59/2017) dalam rangka memenuhi komitmen Indonesia dalam Paris COP (Conference of Parties).

## Referensi Penyusunan Laporan dan Jaminan Eksternal

Laporan ini disusun menggunakan referensi Pedoman Penyusunan Laporan Keberlanjutan Global Reporting Initiatives (GRI), termasuk Financial Services Sector Disclosure (FSSD), dengan pilihan standar "CORE". Laporan ini juga merujuk pada Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Nomor 51/POJK.03/2017 tentang Penerapan Keuangan Berkelanjutan Bagi Lembaga Jasa Keuangan, Emiten, dan Perusahaan Publik (POJK 51/2017). [102-48, 102-49, 102-54]

PermataBank menggunakan prinsip materialitas dalam menetapkan isu-isu yang dinilai penting bagi para pemangku kepentingan dan dalam menjalankan kegiatan usaha.

The Sustainability Report or "Report" of PT Bank Permata Tbk ("PermataBank") for the year 2020 is the sixth since it was first published in 2014. With this Report, PermataBank describes its efforts in realizing its commitment to support national development through easy-to-access banking products and services for all communities. This report consists of the most recent information on PermataBank's sustainability performance in economic, social, and environmental aspects as well as on the corporate governance for stakeholders. The information in this report is complementary to PermataBank's 2020 Annual Report.

This Report also outlines the realization of PermataBank's programs in support of achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) as established by the Indonesian Government through the Presidential Regulation Number 59 of 2017 on the Implementation of the Sustainable Development Goals (PP 59/2017) to show Indonesia's commitment to the Paris COP (Conference of Parties).

## Reporting Reference and External Assurance

This Report was prepared in accordance with the Sustainable Reporting Guidelines, the Global Reporting Initiatives (GRI), including the Financial Services Sector Disclosure (FSSD), with "CORE" standar option. This report also refers to the Financial Services Authority Regulation Number 51/POJK.03/2017 on the Implementation of Sustainable Finance for Financial Services Institutions, Issuers, and Public Companies (POJK 51/2017). [102-48, 102-49, 102-54]

PermataBank applies materiality principle in reporting issues that are important to stakeholders and to its business operations.

Laporan ini menyajikan topik material yang relevan bagi keberlanjutan PermataBank, yaitu informasi tentang komitmen, kebijakan, pelaksanaan, dan kinerja keberlanjutan. This report presents material topics relevant to the sustainability of PermataBank, namely information on sustainability commitment, policies, and performance. # Perubahan Signifikan Selama Periode Pelaporan

Selama periode pelaporan terdapat dual perubahan signifikan yang dapat mempengaruhi kuantitas data keberlanjutan yang disampaikan. Perubahan signifikan pertama adalah realisasi akuisisi kepemilikan saham PermataBank oleh Bangkok Bank Public Company Limited (Bangkok Bank) dari mayoritas pemilik sebelumnya, yakni PT Astra Internasional Tbk dan Standard Chartered Bank. Terhitung sejak 20 Mei 2020 make PermataBank menjadi bagian dari Bangkok Bank. Proses ini diikuti dengan integrasi cabang Bangkok Bank di Indonesia ke dalam PermataBank, sehingga terjadi perubahan struktur manajemen dan struktur operasional PermataBank.

Perubahan signifikan kedua adalah terjadinya pandemi Covid-19 di seluruh dunia termasuk di Indonesia selama tahun 2020. Sebagai akibatnya, PermataBank menerapkan berbagai kebijakan protokol kesehatan yang ketat dalam kegiatan operasional, termasuk dalam pengaturan waktu kerja bagi seluruh jajaran karyawan. PermataBank membelakukan kebijakan Work From Home, diikuti berbagai penyesuaian kebijakan pemantauan aspek keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja karyawan.

Pada periode pelaporan ini, tidak ada pernyataan ulang (restatement) atas informasi yang disajikan tahun lalu. [102-10, 102-48]

Topik material yang dilaporkan dalam Laporan ini, sama dengan topik material Laporan tahun sebelumnya. [102-49]

# Significant Changes during the Reporting Period

During the reporting period there were two significant changes that might have affected the quantity of the presented sustainable data. The first significant change was the acquisition of PermataBank shares by Bangkok Bank Public Company Limited (Bangkok Bank) from the previous majority shareholder, PT Astra Internasional Tbk and Standard Chartered Bank. As of 20 May 2020, PermataBank became part of Bangkok Bank. This process was followed up by an integration of branches of Bangkok Bank in Indonesia into PermataBank, creating structural changes in PermataBank's management and operations.

The second significant change was the impact of the Covid-19 pandemic across the globe including in Indonesia during 2020. As a result, PermataBank implemented strict health protocols in its operations, including in managing the work hours of its employees. PermataBank imposed a Work From Home policy followed by several adjusted measures to monitor the safety and health of employees.

In this reporting period, there are no restatements of the information presented in the previous year's report. [102-10, 102-48]

Material topics reported in this Report are the same as the material topics in the previous year's Report. [102-49]
